disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.awaitingHint: Verdicts not settled yet. The hourly sweep settles most of them; a verdict whose order cannot follow it waits here until you choose what happens.
disputes.dispositionTitle: The order cannot follow this verdict as it is
disputes.caseGoodsMoving: The goods are already on the way. The buyer is refunded in full either way; choose what happens to the goods.
disputes.caseBeforeDelivery: The order is not delivered yet. Choose when the farmer is paid. Paying now is possible only once the goods were picked up.
disputes.caseNoFit: If the order or delivery is missing, carries another verdict, or was closed meanwhile, none of the other choices fits: settle as it is.
disputes.disposition_return_to_farmer: Return the goods to the farmer
disputes.dispositionHint_return_to_farmer: The delivery is cancelled and the order closed. The listing stock is not restored; the farmer relists what is still sellable. The trucker is not paid for the trip.
disputes.dispositionHint_delivered_anyway: The delivery counts as delivered and the order is closed.
disputes.dispositionHint_settle_now: The delivery is cancelled and the order closed. The release pays the farmer and, if there is one, the trucker leg. The stock is not restored.
disputes.dispositionHint_wait_for_delivery: Nothing changes now. The farmer is paid once the order is delivered; after seven days of waiting an alarm fires again.
disputes.dispositionHint_settle_as_is: Only when no other choice fits. The money moves as the verdict says; a live order is closed and the delivery is left as it is. A farmer is paid only for goods that left the farm. The stock is not restored.
disputes.auditNote: Every verdict is written to the audit log under your admin account.

trail.loadFailed: The trail could not be loaded.
trail.noDelivery: No delivery is linked to this dispute yet, so there is no trail.
trail.selfPickup: The buyer collected the goods (self-pickup), so there is no truck trail.
trail.notPickedUp: The goods were not picked up yet. The trail starts at pickup.
trail.noCheckIns: No check-ins between pickup and delivery.
trail.windowOpen: From pickup {from} to now (still on the road)
trail.mapLabel: Map of the trail between pickup and drop-off (check-ins: {fixes})
trail.saysGaps: Shared with gaps (stretches of more than 90 minutes without a check-in: {gaps})
trail.saysDeclined: The driver declined sharing (check-ins in this window: {fixes})
trail.saysNoJumps: No impossible jumps; the fastest leg was {kmh} km/h
trail.saysNoLegs: Too few precise check-ins to measure speed
trail.saysMocked: Check-ins flagged as a mock location: {count}
trail.saysCoarse: Coarse check-ins (accuracy worse than 1,000 m), shown but not used for speed: {count}
trail.saysLate: Check-ins sent late (more than 15 minutes after they were taken): {count}
trail.reminder: The trail shows where the truck was, not what it carried. Weigh it with the photos, weights and messages.
trail.saysAwayStops: Stops off the stop list (more than 5 km from every planned stop and QR scan): {count}
trail.saysNoAwayStops: Every pause was at a planned stop or a QR scan
trail.awayStopRange: {from} to {until} at {place}, {km} km from the nearest planned stop or QR scan

evidence.loadFailed: The evidence could not be loaded.
evidence.noHandoffs: No handoff yet: the goods were not picked up.
evidence.whoUnknown: Who made the handoff is not recorded.
evidence.noGps: No GPS fix at the handoff
evidence.photosNote: Photo links expire after 15 minutes. Reload the page for new ones.
evidence.arrivalPhotoLate: Attached late, after the delivery deadline, once this dispute was open.
evidence.dropoffPhotoLate: Attached late, without the buyer's confirm, once the system had opened this dispute.
evidence.messagesPrivate: The parties' messages are private. Open them only to decide this dispute: every read is written to the audit log under your admin account.
evidence.messagesFailed: The messages could not be loaded.
evidence.noMessages: No messages on this order or its delivery.
evidence.messagesAudited: Read-only. This read was written to the audit log.
evidence.messagesTruncated: A thread holds more messages than shown: only its newest 100 are here.

payouts.title: Manual Payouts
payouts.subtitle: Settlements the Telebirr gateway could not make. Pay each leg in the Telebirr merchant portal, then record the portal transaction ID here.
payouts.refMissingHint: Gateway reported paid without a reference. Find it in the portal and record its ID; pay only if it is missing.
payouts.outcomeUnknownHint: Telebirr may already have paid this leg. Search the portal for {gatewayRef}. If it is not there, wait and search again before paying: a payment can show up late. Record its ID if you find it; pay only if it is still missing.
payouts.confirmFound: The portal shows {amount} paid to {phone} under this ID?
payouts.loadFailed: The payout queue could not be loaded. Reload before paying anything.
payouts.deliveredWarning: Delivery was confirmed after this refund was queued. Check with the buyer and the farmer before refunding.
payouts.verdictConflict: The dispute verdict is {verdict}, but this payout goes the other way (its lock was taken before the verdict). Do not pay it: check the escrow history first.
payouts.claimHint: Claim this leg before you pay it in the portal. The transaction ID field appears once you hold the claim.
payouts.claimDone: Leg claimed for 30 minutes. Pay it in the portal, then record the transaction ID.
payouts.claimLapsedMine: Your claim lapsed at {time}. Check the portal, then claim it again before you pay or record anything.
payouts.claimLapsedOther: Last claimed by {admin}, lapsed at {time}: they may have paid it. Check the portal before you pay.
payouts.claimedOnRecord: {admin} holds the claim on this leg. Do not pay it again: if you already paid it in the portal, contact {admin} so it is recorded once.
payouts.claimChanged: This leg changed while you claimed it (recorded, released or busy). The list is reloaded: check it and try again.
payouts.claimedByYou: You are paying this leg (claimed until {time}).
payouts.claimedByOtherHint: Claimed by {admin} until {time}. Do not pay it in the portal.
payouts.duplicateRef: This Telebirr transaction ID is already recorded on escrow {escrowId}, leg {ref}. Check the ID in the portal: one payment cannot be recorded twice.
payouts.openToCorrect: Open escrow {escrowId} to correct the ID recorded there.

correctRef.title: Correct the recorded Telebirr transaction ID
correctRef.hint: Use this only when this leg was recorded with the wrong ID. Nothing is paid or refunded: only the recorded ID changes, and the audit trail keeps both.
correctRef.reason: Why the recorded ID is wrong
correctRef.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters. It is kept in the audit trail.
correctRef.already: This leg already carries that ID.
correctRef.sameRef: Enter an ID that differs from the recorded one.
correctRef.changed: This leg changed since the page was loaded. Reload and check its ID before you try again.
correctRef.notCorrectable: This leg cannot be corrected here: it is not recorded yet, or the gateway paid it.

doubleEscrow.title: Second payment for this order
doubleEscrow.explain: The order's own escrow ({orderEscrowStatus}) already holds or paid this trade's money, so this escrow is a second payment. The hourly sweep never settles it.
doubleEscrow.action: Refund this payment to the buyer
doubleEscrow.hint: The buyer gets this escrow's amount back through Telebirr. The order, its delivery and the order's own escrow do not change. Your name and reason are kept in the audit trail.
doubleEscrow.reason: Why this is a second payment
doubleEscrow.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters. It is kept in the audit trail.
doubleEscrow.queued: The refund waits in Manual Payouts. Pay it there and record the Telebirr transaction ID.

cancelDelivery.title: Cancel this delivery after pickup
cancelDelivery.hint: Use this when the goods were picked up and will not reach the buyer. Only the delivery is cancelled: no money moves and the order keeps its status. The order cannot get a new delivery afterwards.
cancelDelivery.moneyFirst: The payment is still held ({status}). Decide the money first: a dispute verdict (which cancels the delivery itself) or the override refund (API only for now). Then this delivery can be cancelled here.
cancelDelivery.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters. It is kept in the audit trail.
cancelDelivery.confirmQuestion: Cancel this delivery? This cannot be undone.

pickup.title: Pickup judgement
pickup.judgement_trucker_no_show: The trucker did not show up
pickup.judgement_farmer_no_show: The farmer did not show up
pickup.judgement_buyer_no_show: The buyer did not come to collect
pickup.judgement_unchecked_check_in: The arrival could not be measured
pickup.late: Late: received after the deadline, kept as evidence, not counted
pickup.outOfRange: More than 5 km away: kept, counted as not measured
pickup.exit_pending: Back to pending with a new deadline
pickup.noShowHint: A no-show judgement moved this order on (the transport failed, or the order was cancelled with its refund armed), so it cannot be re-opened here. A wrong no-show is excused on the party's reputation page.
pickup.truckerNoShowHint: The trucker was judged absent: the delivery was cancelled, the trip booking released, and the buyer chooses the transport again. If a scan that reached the server late shows the crops left the farm, re-open the no-show below while the buyer has not chosen; the trucker's no-show is excused with it.

reopen.title: Re-open this judged pickup
reopen.hint: Use this only after you have reconciled what really happened with the parties, for example a scan that reached the server too late. No money moves.
reopen.exitPendingHelp: The parties get a new window: the trucker (or the buyer collecting) scans the farmer's QR, and the order is judged again at the new deadline. The check-ins are kept.
reopen.exitHandoffHelp: The crops changed hands: the delivery is marked picked up and the order goes on as after a scan. The buyer confirms the drop-off with the trucker's drop-off code as usual; a trucker whose phone shows none makes a New drop-off code.
reopen.confirmPending: Re-open the pickup with a new deadline {hours} hours from now?
reopen.confirmHandoff: Record the handoff as picked up?
reopen.donePending: The pickup is open again until the new deadline.
reopen.doneHandoff: The handoff is recorded as picked up.
reopen.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters. It is kept in the audit trail.

noShowReopen.title: Re-open this trucker no-show
noShowReopen.hint: Use this only after you have checked with the parties that the trucker came, for example a real scan that reached the server late. The trip booking is taken back and the trucker's no-show is excused. No money moves.
noShowReopen.exitPendingHelp: The trucker gets a new window: the order is agreed again, the trucker creates a new delivery and scans the farmer's QR, and the order is judged again at the new deadline. The judged window's check-ins are cleared (the audit trail keeps them), so both check in again.
noShowReopen.exitHandoffHelp: The crops changed hands: the cancelled delivery is marked picked up and the order goes on as after a scan. The buyer confirms the drop-off with the trucker's drop-off code as usual; a trucker whose phone shows none makes a New drop-off code.
noShowReopen.confirmPending: Re-open the no-show with a new deadline {hours} hours from now, take the trip booking back and excuse the trucker's no-show?
noShowReopen.confirmHandoff: Record the handoff as picked up, take the trip booking back and excuse the trucker's no-show?
noShowReopen.donePending: The no-show is re-opened: the trucker has a new window until the new deadline.
noShowReopen.doneHandoff: The handoff is recorded as picked up and the trip booking is back.

pickup.noShowEvent_already_excused: The trucker's no-show was already excused.
pickup.noShowEvent_not_recorded: No no-show is recorded for this order on the trucker's reputation. If one appears later, excuse it on the trucker's reputation page.
pickup.noShowEvent_not_counted: The trucker's no-show no longer counts, so there was nothing to excuse.
pickup.noShowEvent_upheld: The trucker's no-show was upheld earlier and stays. Check it on the trucker's reputation page.
pickup.noShowEvent_off: Reputation penalties are off here, so no no-show was recorded.
pickup.noShowEvent_failed: The trucker's no-show could not be excused. Excuse it on the trucker's reputation page.

listingReports.title: Listing Reports
listingReports.subtitle: Buyers report crop listings and trips that hide a phone number (a voice note or a photo cannot be checked), mislead or look like a scam. Decide the reports of each listing together. To act on the owner, open their page and suspend them, then mark the reports actioned. The owner never sees who reported.
listingReports.listingGone: This listing no longer exists, or could not be read.
listingReports.alreadyDecided: These reports were already decided. Reload the page.
listingReports.loadFailed: The reports could not be loaded. Reload the page.

unapplied.title: Unapplied Payments
unapplied.subtitle: Payments Telebirr captured that never reached their order: a cancelled or missing order, a second payment, or a payment that could not be processed. Refund each one in the Telebirr merchant portal, then record the refund here. Recording moves no order and no escrow.
unapplied.empty: No captured payment is waiting for a refund.
unapplied.emptySoFar: None found in this part of the history. Load more to keep searching.
unapplied.paymentUnknown: The payment order ID is not known. Search the portal for checkout {merchOrderId}.
unapplied.reason_no_payment_order_id: Telebirr sent no payment order ID
unapplied.reason_replay_exhausted: Processing gave up after repeated tries
unapplied.error_ESCROW_036: This reference conflicts with one already recorded for this order. Reload and check.
unapplied.capturedUnknown: Not on record. Read the amount in the portal.
unapplied.mayStillApply: Telebirr may still deliver this payment to its order. Do not refund it yet.
unapplied.confirmRefund: You refunded {amount} for payment {payment} in the portal, under {ref}?
unapplied.recordedUnchecked: Refund recorded. The captured amount was not on record, so the amount was not checked.
unapplied.loadFailed: The unapplied payments could not be loaded. Reload before refunding anything.

fraud.title: Fraud Review
fraud.confirmReject: Rejecting suspends the account and signs the user out.
fraud.result_approve: Signal approved. It no longer counts toward this user's risk score.
fraud.result_reject: Signal rejected. User {userId} is suspended (fraud confirmed).
fraud.result_sessionsNotEnded: The sign-in service was not updated, so the user may stay signed in until the session expires.
fraud.result_whitelist: Signal whitelisted. This signal no longer counts, and this user's soft signals do not count until {date}.
fraud.openEscrowsHint: Nothing was held now. The next settlement sweep holds each of these escrows when it comes due.
fraud.noOpenEscrows: This user has no open escrows.
fraud.openEscrowsIncomplete: This list may be incomplete. Check the Escrows page.
fraud.error_ADMIN_006: This signal was not found, or it is not a signal. Reload the page.
fraud.error_ADMIN_007: The user of this signal was not found, so no account was suspended. The signal is still pending.
fraud.subtitle: Signals grouped by user, newest first, with each user's risk score. Escrows held for fraud review wait in their own tab for a release or a refund.
fraud.hourNote: One row stands for every refusal of its type in one hour. The time shown is the first one.
fraud.scoreTruncated: Too many signals to read in full, so this user counts as critical.
fraud.aiAdviceNote: Written by an AI model from this user's signals. It is advice, not a decision: it adds a few points at most, never makes a user critical, and never holds or moves money.
fraud.scoreBreakdown: Rules {rules} + AI advice {ai}. Critical is decided by the rules alone.
fraud.loadFailed: This list could not be loaded. Reload the page.
fraud.emptyReviewed: No reviewed signals in the last 30 days.
fraud.heldHint: A settlement sweep froze these escrows for fraud review. Release pays the farmer (and the trucker); refund returns the money to the buyer. Either one needs a reason, kept in the audit trail.
fraud.reasonPlaceholder: Why this decision, for the audit trail
fraud.confirm_release: Release {amount} now? This pays the farmer and, when there is one, the trucker.
fraud.verdictOnly_release: The dispute verdict (farmer wins) allows a release only.
fraud.verdictOnly_refund: The dispute verdict (buyer wins) allows a refund only.
fraud.error_ESCROW_VALIDATION: Enter a reason of 10 to 500 characters.
fraud.error_ESCROW_INVALID_TRANSITION: This escrow cannot be settled that way now: its order or its verdict does not allow it. Open the transaction timeline.

stuckOrders.subtitle: Orders that stopped moving. Open one to see the whole transaction. Nothing on this page moves money.
stuckOrders.hint_queue: Paid orders whose money was held 21 days and whose order is still not done. An admin decides each one.
stuckOrders.hint_deadline: Orders past a deadline by more than 30 minutes that the deadline run did not act on: no farmer answer, no trucker answer, no transport choice by the buyer, or a pickup that is overdue. After them, the orders still not picked up after the overdue pickup notice went out.

stuckOrders.reason_both_present_no_scan: Both checked in, nothing scanned, an admin decides

stuckOrders.reason_pickup_waiting: Pickup overdue, the notice was sent, still not picked up

reputation.tagLow: Low reputation tag set by an admin
reputation.tagClear: Low reputation tag hidden by an admin
reputation.restrictionReview: since {since}, until an admin decides the review
reputation.help_tag: Buyers will see the Low reputation label on this account's listings whatever its points, until the date you set.
reputation.help_untag: Buyers will not see the Low reputation label on this account until the date you set, even if its points would show it. A restriction stays.
reputation.help_restrict: The account cannot create listings or trips or accept new orders until the date you set. Its current orders continue.
reputation.help_lift: Ends the restriction now. The points stay, so the tier follows the points.
reputation.help_excuse: The event stops counting: its points are removed and a restriction caused by them is lifted. The account holder sees your note.
reputation.help_uphold: The appeal is closed and the points stay. The account holder sees your note.
reputation.help_upholdReview: The points stay and the restriction gets an end date: the one you set, or 14 days from now if you leave it empty. The account holder sees your note.
reputation.note: Note to the account holder (3 to 500 characters)
reputation.reasonInvalid: Write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
reputation.untilInvalid: Choose a date after today and at most {days} days ahead.
reputation.alreadyDone: This was already done. Nothing changed.
reputation.photoExpired: The photo link has expired or is missing. Reload the page.
reputation.appealsSubtitle: Farmers and truckers can ask an admin to excuse a penalty, once per event, with a text and an optional photo. An overdue delivery restricts the trucker until an admin reviews it. Oldest first. Accepting excuses the event; upholding keeps the points. The account holder reads your note.
reputation.appealsLoadFailed: The appeals could not be loaded. Reload the page.
reputation.noText: The account holder has not written anything.
